title: Spectral Rice Damage Evidence Ledger
dataset: GD-RGBMS-DB: UAV RGB and Multispectral Dataset for Rice Grain Discoloration Segmentation, Zenodo 17008818
blocker: Measured source has only two physical field clusters and three contiguous flight sessions on one date; no stable group-safe hidden split is possible.
status_note: Rejected at the pilot gate. Extra crops would increase rows but not independent source families, and the upstream random-frame lists mix adjacent flight frames across every split.

evidence.license_evidence: Captured Zenodo API metadata reports metadata.license.id=cc-by-4.0 and access_right=open. The archive contains readmes but no separate license or conflicting rights notice.

archive_join.ms_format: three-channel PNG composite described by the archive readme as Green, Red Edge, and NIR

independent_family_audit.conclusion: Any group-safe split has only one held-out field or one held-out flight session. Crop variants cannot repair independent-family scarcity.

evidence.semantic_duplicate_audit: No exact local duplicate. Closest local analogue is the blocked Multispectral Undertext Reading With Spatial Evidence challenge; closest public families are canonical RGB/MS segmentation, mask refinement, and multimodal sensor-failure segmentation.
evidence.capability_baselines: Not run after terminal group-stability failure; a random-frame result would be leaky and a three-session fold would be too unstable to certify readiness.
evidence.null_metric_audit: Not run because the terminal pilot rejection prevented creation or tuning of a full grader.
evidence.lookup_risk: Not passed. The source is public and exposes exact UAV filenames, timestamps, coordinates, altitude, and neighboring frames. Exact copies, ordinary resizes, or ordinary crops would be visually fingerprintable; no transformed public package was built after rejection.
evidence.import_route: Direct official URL import is live and the exact file is below 1 GB decimal. Untouched-file fallback is the verified official GD-RGBMS-DB.zip with the same byte count and MD5.

not_run_after_terminal_rejection: Full grader null and malformed-input battery

notes: Pilot downloaded and verified the exact official ZIP, inspected every archive member, joined all 400 RGB/MS/mask triplets, and decoded all image headers and masks.
Native targets pass provenance: every Mark PNG is a non-empty two-colour source annotation aligned at 1200x900 with its RGB and MS files.

Scale and split stability fail: one date, two physical field clusters, three contiguous acquisition sessions, and 400 tightly spaced frames are not enough independent source families for a stable structured image challenge.
The official train/validation/test lists are unusable for this challenge because every split mixes both fields and all three sessions.
Full build was not started. The named Sprint 5 folder is an audit-only rejection package and contains no prepare.py, grade.py, solution notebook, config, or participant-facing challenge description.
Preferred provenance route remains the official direct URL. The only fallback is the untouched verified official GD-RGBMS-DB.zip; no processed raw ZIP was created.
The readiness validator was run and correctly returned NOT BUILD READY because verdict=Reject and the scale, split, lookup, capability-baseline, and null-metric gates are not passed.
Challenge-specific pilot evidence and the untouched official ZIP were relocated into the named Sprint 5 folder. This authoritative registry record remains at the shared coordination path by design.

The final adversarial audit checked all 3,405 lines of prev_reviews.txt, scanned 33 accepted challenge descriptions, and confirmed that the current formulation remains rejected and has no submission-ready grader or description.
